title: Dialogue, Social Scene, Rumor & Conditional Content Integration
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Dialogue, Social Scene, Rumor and Conditional Content Integration over the MAS-01..13 foundations while preserving canonical dialogue/conversation, social interaction, CNI conditional-content, visibility/reveal and Action/Event/runtime owner authority and keeping prepared integrations distinct from live dialogue, occurrence, reveal or condition execution.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Dialogue, Social Scene, Rumor and Conditional Content integrations inside the MAS workspace without turning prepared integrations into canonical conversation/social state, player-visible rumor/reveal state, CNI condition execution or live Action/Event truth.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically integrate prepared dialogue, social-scene, rumor and conditional-content references over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner/runtime references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner authority and never treating prepared integrations as executed live dialogue, social occurrence, rumor reveal or condition truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-13 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

CNI-05 retained executable dialogue graph/effect-proposal authority; CNI-04 retained predicate/query evaluation; A9/social-relations retained live social interaction state; Knowledge/KFR retained rumor knowledge/familiarity; visibility/reveal and Action/Event/CNI runtime owners retained live disclosure, execution and mutation authority.
Prepared integrations never proved live dialogue execution, social occurrence, conditional evaluation, rumor reveal/player knowledge, visibility mutation or Action/Event truth.
MAS-14 consumed explicit MAS-13 prepared references plus validated SocialInteraction, Knowledge and Visibility owner bindings and explicit CNI-05/CNI-04 references; unresolved references fail closed.
Production code remained frozen after minimum GREEN ab776b48d850f3f0b1369733a00536afcb7a70d9; the proof layer added governance/compliance/verifier surfaces only.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-14.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-14, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-15 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-16+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-14 is closed. MAS-15 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
